Preheat oven to 325°F. Line three 8-inch round pans with parchment. 2. Whisk dry ingredients together. 3. In a separate bowl, whisk wet ingredients together. 4. Add dry ingredients to wet. Whisk until smooth. 5. Let batter sit for 5 minutes, then whisk again for 10 seconds. 6. Divide evenly between pans. 7. Bake at 325°F for 25 minutes, until centers are set. 8. Cool 10-15 minutes in pans, then remove/cool completely. Filling Ingredients 120 g butter of choice (3 sticks) 60 g heavy cream of choice (~1/4 cup) 120 g powdered sugar (1 cup) 20 g light corn syrup (1 tbsp) 1 tbsp vanilla bean paste ⅛ tsp fine sea salt Instructions 1. Heat butter and heavy cream together until fully melted and smooth. 2. Whisk in powdered sugar until completely smooth and glossy. 3. Add syrup, vanilla, and salt.  4. Let sit until cool & slightly thickened. Buttercream Ingredients 340 g (3 sticks) butter of choice 520 g (4 cups) powdered sugar 1 tbsp vanilla bean paste ¼ tsp fine sea salt 40 g (3 tbsp) heavy cream of choice Instructions 1. Beat butter for 3-5 minutes until light and fluffy. 2. Add powdered sugar and mix for 5-7 minutes. 3. Add vanilla bean paste and salt. 4. Slowly stream in heavy cream and mix on low Assembly 1. Chocolate Brownie Lava Cake 🍫🌋 Ingredients: - For Chocolate Sponge - • 240g plain flour • 30g cocoa powder • 400g granulated sugar • 2tsp bicarbonate of soda • 1tsp baking powder • 240ml milk • 110g vegetable oil • 2 large eggs • 1tsp vanilla extract • 50g milk chocolate • 150ml hot water - For Chocolate Icing - • 250g unsalted butter • 500g icing sugar • 50g cocoa powder • 1tsp vanilla extract • 3tbsp milk - For Brownie Lava - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 70g unsalted butter • 40g cocoa powder • 40g plain flour (heat treated) • 80g double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 70g milk chocolate - For Brownie Bites - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 90g unsalted butter • 60g cocoa powder • 120g plain flour (heat treated) • 2-3tbsp double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 100g chocolate chips Instructions: - For Chocolate Sponge - 1) In a large bowl, combine your flour, cocoa powder, granulated sugar, bicarbonate of soda, and baking powder 2) In another bowl, whisk together your milk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and 50g melted milk chocolate 3) Fold in your dry ingredients from before and add in 150ml hot water or coffee 4) Line three 8” cake tins and pour in the batter evenly. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 25 minutes - For Icing - 1) Whisk your butter until light and creamy 2) Add in your icing sugar and cocoa powder 3) Once incorporated, whisk in your vanilla and milk until fluffy  - For Brownie Lava - 1) Melt the butter with both sugars over a medium heat 2) Whisk in the cocoa powder and flour 3) Gradually add in the cream until molten and thick, then stir in the vanilla extract and salt 4) Let it cool to just above room temperature and then add in the milk chocolate to slowly melt in 5) Once the lava has reached room temperature, you can use it on your cake! - For Bronwie Bites - 1) Cream together the butter and both sugars until fluffy 2) Mix in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until sandy 3) Add in the vanilla extract and double cream 4) Once it has become a dough, fold in your chocolate chips, then press it firmly into a lined 9x9” square tin, refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small bite sized pieces  Watch the video to see how I build and decorate the cake! I find it’s easier to ice the sponges when they are frozen/cold. Enjoy! :) #chocolate #cake #brownie #baking #recipes

VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

🌋🤎 Mini Dark Chocolate Lava Cakes 🤎🌋 Ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 ml) salted butter 6 oz dark chocolate  2 eggs 2 egg yolks 1/4 cup unpacked brown sugar (40g) 2 tbsp flour Pinch of salt For serving: Powdered sugar Vanilla ice cream Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425°F. 2. Grease 6 cups in a standard muffin tin with butter. 3. Melt: Melt butter & chocolate together in a saucepan over low heat, or in the microwave on high. Stir every 30 seconds until smooth.  4. Mix batter: In a medium bowl, beat eggs, egg yolks, brown sugar, & salt until slightly thickened. Whisk in the chocolate mixture. Fold in the flour until just combined. 5. Fill the tin: Divide batter among 6 of the muffin tin cups (about 3/4 full). 6. Bake: Bake for 7–9 minutes. Pull them out as soon as the tops set. 7. Cool & serve: Let sit for 2–3 minutes before serving. Gently remove the cakes from the muffin tin. Serve with a dusting of powdered sugar & vanilla ice cream. BRIGADEIRO VOLCANO CAKE 🥕🐇🍫 This is a classic Brigadeiro Carrot Cake I grew up eating: super soft, moist, and topped with warm brigadeiro  Recipe Cake 400g carrots, peeled and chopped 6 eggs 2½ cups sugar 1½ cups neutral oil 4 cups all-purpose flour (sifted) 2 tbsp baking powder 1 pinch salt Preheat oven to 340°F / 170°C and grease a 15-cup bundt pan well. Blend the carrots and oil for about 1 minute, add the eggs and sugar and blend 2-3 minutes until completely smooth. In a bowl, sift the flour, pour in the carrot mixture and mix gently just until combined. Add a pinch of salt and the baking powder last and mix lightly. Pour into the pan, tap it a couple times on the counter to release air bubbles, and bake 50-60 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean. Let cool 10-15 minutes before removing from the pan. Brigadeiro Topping 2 cans sweetened condensed milk 4 tbsp cocoa powder 1 tbsp butter 7 oz / 200 g heavy cream Cook the condensed milk, cocoa, and butter over medium-low heat, stirring constantly until slightly thickened. Turn off the heat and stir in the heavy cream to make it silky and pourable. TIP: mix the cocoa powder with a bit of heavy cream first before adding to the condensed milk mixture While it's still warm, pour it over the center of the cake and let it overtlow.

videos.caption: ¡Dale un Efecto Wow a tu Pastel! 🎂✨ Las velas volcán no son simples velas; son una experiencia visual que transforma el momento de “Cantar el Cumpleaños” en un verdadero espectáculo. Diseñadas para emitir una columna de chispas brillantes y constantes, estas velas crean un ambiente festivo, elegante y lleno de energía. ¿Por qué elegirlas para tu próximo cumple? Efecto Cinematográfico: Proyectan una luz vibrante que luce increíble en fotos y videos (¡perfectas para Reels y TikTok!). Larga Duración: Tienen una combustión constante que dura entre 30 y 60 segundos, dándote tiempo de sobra para cantar y pedir tus deseos. Seguridad Primero: Están diseñadas para uso en interiores, produciendo un humo mínimo y chispas frías que no dañan el pastel ni queman al contacto accidental. Versatilidad: Su diseño con base puntiaguda permite fijarlas fácilmente en cualquier superficie blanda, desde pasteles y donas hasta botellas de champaña. Instrucciones de Uso Seguro: Colocación: Inserta la base de plástico firmemente en el pastel de forma vertical. Encendido: Enciende el papel de seda superior con un encendedor o fósforo (no es necesario quitar el papel). Distancia: Mantén una distancia de unos 50 cm mientras la vela esté activa. Finalización: Espera unos segundos después de que se apague antes de retirarla, ya que el cartucho puede estar caliente. Tip Pro: Si quieres una foto épica, utiliza dos velas volcán en lugar de una para crear un arco de luz simétrico detrás del pastel. ¡El cumpleañero se sentirá como una verdadera estrella! 🌟 #Cumpleaños #veñas #oferta #puertolacruz #lechería

Oreo Chocolate Volcano Cake. 
 Ingredients 
 Chocolate Sponge Cake
 ● 45g corn oil, about 3 tbsp
 ● 65g whole milk, about 1/4 cup
 ● 55g cake flour, about 1/2 cup
 ● 15g unsweetened cocoa powder, about 2 tbsp
 ● 5 large eggs, separated
 ● 50g granulated sugar, about 1/4 cup
 ● A few drops fresh lemon juice 
 Whipped Cream
 ● 400g heavy whipping cream, about 1 2/3 cups
 ● 30g granulated sugar, about 2 1/2 tbsp 
 Chocolate Ganache
 ● 70g heavy whipping cream, about 1/4 cup + 2 tsp
 ● 50g chocolate, finely chopped 
 Oreo Layer & Topping
 ● Oreo cookies, crushed, as needed 
 Making Process 
 1. Make the Chocolate Ganache
 ● Warm the 70g heavy cream and pour it over the chocolate. Stir until completely melted and
 glossy. Set aside to cool slightly. 
 2. Make the Chocolate Batter
 ● Whisk the corn oil and milk until emulsified. Sift in the cake flour and cocoa powder, then
 mix in the egg yolks until smooth. 
 3. Whip the Meringue
 ● Add a few drops of lemon juice to the egg whites. Gradually add the sugar and whip until
 the meringue holds soft-to-medium peaks. Gently fold it into the chocolate batter. 
 4. Bake the Sponge  ● Spread the batter evenly in a lined sheet pan. Bake at 300°F / 150°C for 30 minutes. Cool completely, then cut the sponge into the cake pieces needed for layering. 
 5. Whip the Cream
 ● Beat the heavy whipping cream with the sugar until thick, smooth, and firm enough for filling and frosting. 
 6. Build the Oreo Layers
 ● Layer the chocolate sponge with whipped cream and crushed Oreos, keeping an opening
 in the center to create the volcano effect shown in the video. 
 7. Frost & Chill
 ● Cover the assembled cake with whipped cream and smooth the outside. Chill until firm enough to hold its shape. 
 8. Create the Chocolate Volcano
 ● Fill the center generously with chocolate ganache so it flows over the top and down the
 sides. Finish with plenty of crushed Oreo pieces for the crunchy final layer.
